title: Session payloads
description: Payload schemas for the session.* event family.

source.description: The kind of start, passed through from the runtime's SessionStart input: startup, resume or clear for Claude Code. Not an enum, so a source the runtime adds later still validates.

parent_session_id.description: The session that spawned this one, such as a `claude -p` run from another session's shell. Absent when no spawning session was found, which includes a person starting the session. Distinct from resume_of_session_id, which names the session this one continues.

attended.description: Whether a person is driving the session. False for a headless run (`claude -p`), including one with no parent_session_id, such as a run started by cron or a script.
